ngwe25.title: Libra: how you love in winter
ngwe25.caption: Libra, you love by making everything lovely: the lights, the mugs, the whole room. It's sweet. Just remember the person came for you, not the decor. You are the cozy part.

ngwe26.title: Libra: the holiday blind spot
ngwe26.caption: Three invites, one Saturday, three yeses. Saying no to a party isn't letting anyone down, it's saving a yes for yourself. One plan is plenty this month.

ngwe27.title: Libra: the gift you secretly want
ngwe27.caption: You choose for everyone all year. The kindest gift for a Libra is someone who says "I picked the place, just show up." Send this to the person who should.

ngwe28.title: Libra: one word for the new year
ngwe28.caption: Libra, your word for next year is ask. Ask for the table you want and the time you need, then give people the chance to say yes. You might be surprised.

ngwe29.title: Scorpio: how you love in winter
ngwe29.caption: Scorpio, you remember the small things: their colour, their oat milk, their cold ears. That's a quiet kind of devotion. Let them hear the big thing out loud too.

ngwe30.title: Scorpio: the holiday blind spot
ngwe30.caption: Keeping a list of who didn't text back over the holidays? It only gets longer. Tell people you missed them, then let the rest go. Close the ledger.
